en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of a cobblestone market square lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. A church tower with a tall spire dominates the background. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk in the street. The caption at the top reads "Aschersleben. Markt," indicating it shows the central market area of Aschersleben. Additional small printed text appears along the bottom margin with the publisher and date.
